title: i to V in D minor
trains: In a minor key the chord on the fifth note (V) is major, with the raised seventh note of the key. From i the top note stays and the other two fall a step (fingers 1 and 2), so V stands on its third (in A minor: Am to E/G♯, E stays). The left hand falls a half step too.
